descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S13 「姓名顺序的边界，两个模式：按名还是按姓、两个完全一样的名字」 Name order edges, both contexts: first-name vs last-name order, two identical names

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital and Nursing Home (Today's Visits) each hold 'QA Mary Baker' (room 5), 'QA Zoe Adams' (room 6), 'QA Aaron Zimmer' (room 8). Each also holds two identical 'QA Sam Lee' records, the room-30 one created before the room-3 one. NH units are 'Rm 5', 'Rm 6', 'Rm 8', 'Rm 30', 'Rm 3'

When Choose the name sort on the Hospital list, on Nursing Home Today's Visits and on All Residents

Then The three names come in a name order, not in room order: either first-name order (Aaron Zimmer, Mary Baker, Zoe Adams) or last-name order (Zoe Adams, Mary Baker, Aaron Zimmer)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Judged now (U2, U7): mustAppearInOrderAnyOf [[Aaron Zimmer, Mary Baker, Zoe Adams], [Zoe Adams, Mary Baker, Aaron Zimmer]]. A list still in room order fails both. Recorded for Q3: which of the two orders the app uses. Recorded for Q5: which 'QA Sam Lee' (room 3 or 30, read from the card) comes first, room tie-break vs creation order. …
